items.statement: What can the supplied time- and intensity-dependent diffraction-ring observations establish about the nonlinear optical response of INP in chloroform, and which physical properties remain unidentifiable from those observations?
items.expected: Provide an evidence-backed account of observable response and the limits of physical inference. A quantitatively demonstrated non-identifiability conclusion can complete this scoped question. Do not penalize inability to infer unavailable independent calibration; do not award completion for listing its absence without data analysis.
